title: Food, beer and hours at the picnics
summary: Describes the potato salad and ham, paper plates, keg beer, benches or chairs, and the band playing from about eleven till evening.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: And straight chairs I guess or something like that. What kind of chairs? Straight chairs. It's on there straight chairs and the people would be sitting around there. Would they have the chairs in the middle of the floor? No, no chairs for the people. They would have to have to have to have to have to have to have to have them. Oh I see. People would have to sit down. They would stand and walk and dance. Do they have food at these affairs? Have what? Food for them? Oh yeah. Food and chairs. Well beer, you know, no whiskey. Soft drinks and billiards they have. There you go. Tell me about the food. I'd like to hear about that. Well they take and they make maybe a couple of dish pans of potato salad and buy a ham or two and boil them and prepare them, you know. And they fix up the food at home and take it out there and all they have to do is just make the sandwiches or the plates whatever it is. To be a problem. Yeah. They just use those paper plates.
What did they have, like a long table with the food on it?

Well they had a table they'd use. They'd put up a table sometime. But most of the time you just get your food, you know, go off and eat it. They'd had seats around the side, all around the side. You know, something like that. I don't know if you've ever been in. You have never been in the frozen leahaw. Anyway, that's where some of the halls had seats, you know, all around the wall. Just like a bench. Yeah, like all that jobs I mean I said to.
Do it? No, I don't think so. No, something like that.

They had some benches around the wall. They did? No. I don't know. I don't know. I don't see them. They must have been sitting on my imagination. It seems to me we were sitting on chairs. Yeah, but around the wall I think they had some benches somewhere. I don't know.
Maybe they did. Maybe they did.

Do you remember many of the… Well, I know another one I want to ask you. How did they serve the beer? Would it be in bottles or what? Oh no, keg beer. Keg beer? Yeah, that's all they used to use that time. Things like that. Would the people fish? Very… No. Just good time and pleasure, huh? Just come out there and have a little fun dancing and so forth. How long would it last? What would it last? What would it last? It would last… The band would come out there. I don't exactly remember but the band would come out there around about eleven o'clock. And they would play until about five or six o'clock at the evening. But not at nine. No. What bands would they have out there now? Oh yeah. Used to have Mount Everest… I've forgotten the name of the bands because I was small at them time. Well just some of the people. I just remember some of the people. And Mount Everest… And Mount Everest… And… I remember a big guy I know of… And Mount Everest… And Mount Everest… How many pieces would the bands have? Only one of the bands… And Mount Everest… How many pieces would the bands have?
